function.description: Edit a file by replacing an exact string. Prefer this over file_write for modifying existing files — it only sends the diff region and fails fast if old_string is absent or ambiguous. Fails if old_string does not match exactly once (unless replace_all is true). Paths are relative to /app/workspace/ — use 'project/' prefix for the persistent project folder.
function.name: file_edit

new_string.description: Replacement string. May be empty to delete the match.

old_string.description: Exact string to replace. Must match byte-for-byte including whitespace and indentation.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring exactly one. Default: false.
